Financial figures are from the FY2025 Form 10-K (accession 0001506293-26-000021, filed February 12, 2026), checked against SEC XBRL; ownership is from the 2026 proxy (DEF 14A filed April 8, 2026, accession 0001506293-26-000058), as of the March 27, 2026 record date. LEADER: Ben Silbermann is co-founder and non-executive Chair. The proxy states 46.32% of Class B and 35.33% of total voting power but no percentage of all shares, so pctEconomic is null and the computed figure is in leader.derived. The record-date Class A count (496,121,510) is well below the 10-K cover count (585,458,698 at February 6, 2026) because of a $1.0 billion accelerated share repurchase in March 2026 (Q3 2026 10-Q). The proxy says his figure does not include 8,762,530 Class B shares held by an LLC owned by a trust whose beneficiaries include members of his immediate family, over which he has no voting or dispositive power; those are not added. HOLDERS: largestHolders is null, not empty. The proxy's other 5% holders are Paul Sciarra (32,589,537 Class B, 40.90% of Class B, 31.19% of votes), BlackRock (59,584,440 Class A, 12.01% of Class A, per a 13G/A reporting holdings at December 31, 2025) and The Vanguard Group (60,147,395 Class A, 12.12% of Class A, per a 13G/A reporting holdings at November 29, 2024, which Vanguard said on March 27, 2026 it no longer beneficially owns after an internal realignment); those are percentages of a single class, and only the leader's figure may be derived. BUYBACKS exclude $398.982 million of shares repurchased for tax withholdings on the release of RSUs and RSAs (a separate cash-flow line). The cash-flow line ($927.013 million) is used; the equity statement shows $930.263 million. GEOGRAPHY: United States alone was $2,912.0 million; Europe includes Russia and Turkey (10-K footnotes).
